Caption: 

———————————————————————————

Hi all, happy Tuesday! Crypto remained rotational to start the week, with BTC under pressure, L2s leading and Riot’s Anthropic deal reinforcing the growing importance of AI infrastructure to miner valuations. Today, we look at Fomo’s record $3.2M revenue week, its climb into the App Store’s top 10 Finance apps and why its growth could provide another tailwind for PUMP.

———————————————————————————

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/42e942ec-f31d-4957-8722-a3ac7b121e1e/0xR_NL_Market_Update.png?t=1767631151) [Market Update]
Caption: 

Bitcoin and the broader token market remained under pressure on Monday as sector leadership continued to rotate. BTC fell -1.4% while the S&P 500 remained virtually flat. L2s (5.7%) led the sector board by a wide margin, followed by Perps (2.3%), Solana Eco (2.0%) and DeFi (1.6%). The broader market leaned slightly negative, with 14 of 26 crypto indices finishing lower. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/4db8787f-452d-482c-8d8c-35603ccc12a1/image.png?t=1786451683)
Caption: 

Looking back over the full week, leadership remained similarly concentrated. L2s gained 7.7% on the week, with Monday accounting for most of the move. Bittensor Ecosystem fell -3.0% on Monday but remains the strongest sector over the period, up 9.1%, while Solana Eco finished the week down -1.9% after trading more than 10% higher early on. 

Crypto Miners remain the clearest area of sustained weakness, falling another -2.7% on Monday and -15.0% over the week. Despite the sector’s recent weakness, Riot reportedly signed a [20-year agreement](https://www.riotplatforms.com/riot-platforms-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-and-strategic-highlights/) to provide Anthropic with 191 MW of AI data-center capacity, expected to generate approximately $9.1B in revenue.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/dfccd718-d305-4e19-92a2-f78319ed3b3b/image.png?t=1786451683)
Caption: 

With gains still concentrated among select sectors, this week’s macro releases could provide the next catalyst for a broader move. CPI on Wednesday and PPI on Thursday will be the key releases to watch. Spot BTC ETFs registered $515M of inflows last week across four consecutive positive sessions, while ETH funds added $215M.

77314.subject:
How Is Vibe-Code Rescue Powering the Next Chapter of AI
 Development?
77314.body:
Ment Tech | Meant To Innovate

Автор: Ment Tech Labs


Автор: Ment Tech Labs

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/how-vibe-code-rescue-powering-next-chapter-ai-development-xcb4f?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BPTrXKYytQ2GSCMCGf5hi5Q%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=0uAtzCegyckso1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~msoo52yd~7d-null-null&eid=fz96fz-msoo52yd-7d
  
AI changed how software gets built. It hasn't yet changed how software gets kept alive. Recent developer research puts the share of newly written code that is AI-generated between 41% and 46% globally, and it's still climbing fast. Gartner expects vibe coding techniques to power 40% of new enterprise production software by 2028. For founders, product teams, and engineering leaders, that's no longer a side trend. It's the default way products get built now, and it's quietly creating a second industry right behind it. That second industry is vibe-coding rescue. Early adopters treated AI code generation as a shortcut to a working prototype. Describe the idea, let the model write it, and ship it. The results were real. Build costs for a functional product have fallen sharply, and timelines that used to run months now run weeks. But speed came with a trade-off. Prompt-driven builds routinely skip the parts that keep software alive later, including the following: Error handling for edge cases Authentication and access control Automated tests Documentation of what the AI actually built A data model that can scale past a demo None of that shows up in a prototype. All of it shows up the moment a vibe-coded product meets real users, real data, or investors asking hard questions. Reading the System Comes Before Rewriting It The instinct with a broken AI-generated codebase is to throw it out and start over. Most of the time, that's the wrong call. A proper code rescue begins by mapping what the AI actually built: the data flows, the dependencies, the parts that work and the parts that only look like they work. This is where Vibe Code Rescue Services earn their name. The job isn't to judge how a product got built. It's to stabilise it, close the gaps, and hand back something a team can actually maintain. Practitioners increasingly borrow triage language from emergency response to describe the work: a production outage with paying users on it gets treated as a code 3 rescue, pulled ahead of everything else, while a stalled side project waits its turn. If there's one theme across recent audits of AI-generated code, it's security debt. 77310.subject: Dôležité: Zavedenie silného overenia (SCA) pre prístup do mojedenred.sk
77310.body:
Naše služby ešte bezpečnejšie

English version below

Milý používateľ karty,

 

radi by sme Vás informovali, že sme pre prístup do Vášho užívateľského online účtu na www.mojedenred.sk ( https://www.mojedenred.sk ) zaviedli silné overenie používateľa (SCA). Cieľom je zvýšiť ochranu Vašich údajov.

 

👉 Čo to znamená pre Vás, ak máte stiahnutú aplikáciu Edenred?

* Pri každom prihlasovaní sa do svojho užívateľského online účtu mojedenred.sk budete vyzvaný, aby ste otvorili svoju aplikáciu Edenred pre overenie Vašej identity.

👉 Čo to znamená pre Vás, ak nemáte stiahnutú aplikáciu Edenred?

* Proces prihlásenia zostáva rovnaký, ako doteraz. Budete sa naďalej overovať bezpečnostným kódom zaslaným cez SMS na telefónne číslo uvedené vo Vašom profile. 

❓ Máte otázky? Sme tu pre Vás >>> ( https://www.edenred.sk/kontakty/ )

 

Ďakujeme za spoluprácu a porozumenie,

 

Váš tím Edenred

 

Dear user,

 

we would like to inform you that we have introduced Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) for access to your online user account at www.myedenred.sk ( https://www.myedenred.sk ). The aim is to enhance the protection of your personal data.

 

👉 What does this mean for you if you have the Edenred app installed?

* Each time you log in to your myedenred.sk online account, you will be prompted to open your Edenred app to verify your identity.

👉 What does this mean for you if you do not have the Edenred app installed?

* The login process remains the same as before. You will continue to verify your identity using a security code sent via SMS to the phone number registered in your profile.

❓Have questions? We’re here to help  >>> ( https://www.edenred.sk/kontakty/ )

 

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.

 

Your Edenred team
